description: A slider that either crossfades two inputs or attenuates their sum

params.text: In crossfader mode moves the output from IN 1 at the bottom of the travel to IN 2 at the top; in VCA mode attenuates the two inputs summed, silent at the bottom and full at the top.
Chooses whether the slider crossfades between the two inputs or attenuates their sum.

inputs.text: Reaches the output alone with the slider at the bottom in crossfader mode, and is summed with IN 2 in VCA mode.
Reaches the output alone with the slider at the top in crossfader mode, and is summed with IN 1 in VCA mode.
Moves the slider position a tenth of its travel per volt.

inputs.2:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
